arrangement_disorder.definition: big elements placed/oriented irregularly — furniture LAYOUT, not texture or colour
arrangement_disorder.hypothesis_measure: coarse compressibility (RETIRED for teaching — conflates natural texture with layout; needs element-segmentation + placement-regularity)
arrangement_disorder.teaching_material: arrangement_disorder_schematic.png — hand-built top-down layouts, same furniture, graded: low=regimented / intermediate=slightly off / high=scattered / ambiguous=clustered (two conversation groups: non-grid but intentional)
arrangement_disorder.real_anchors_todo: low = regimented real rooms (auditorium, conference_room — already in corpus); high = a genuinely disarranged room (curate with Stephan — few clean examples in current datasets)

semantic_incongruity.exemplars: MANUAL/SYNTHETIC — curate or composite an out-of-place object; no image-measure ranks this

concealed_order.definition: looks disordered but has hidden structure (model-relative)
concealed_order.exemplars: FRAMING-BASED — same image, expert vs novice framing; not a measure
